descriptionHtml:
The IEEE Communications Society Student Branch Chapter of the University of Peradeniya successfully conducted and showcased the Satellite Image Capturing Antenna Project at EngEx 2025.

During the exhibition, the team demonstrated real-time satellite image reception, highlighting practical applications of communication systems and satellite technology. The project reflected the chapter’s commitment to innovation, hands-on engineering, and excellence in communication technologies.

The event attracted significant interest from visitors, providing an opportunity to share technical knowledge, inspire innovation, and promote IEEE ComSoc activities within the engineering community.

Beyond technology and innovation, EngEx 2025 carried a strong message about how engineering contributes to society. The exhibition demonstrated how public resources is used responsibly to create solutions for a better world. It also served as an inspiration for the next generation, motivating thousands of school students to pursue engineering and innovation. With over 52,000 visitors, EngEx 2025 left a lasting impact as a showcase of knowledge, creativity, and the power of human ingenuity.
